gaps.sentence: The lorry crashed ___ the back of the bus.
His account of the accident tallies ___ the CCTV footage.
gaps.explanation: 'Tally with' = correspond exactly to something else.

gaps.sentence: Everyone laughed ___ his impression of the headmaster.
She soon got tired ___ answering the same questions.
gaps.explanation: tired OF something = bored/annoyed by it; tired FROM = physically exhausted.

gaps.sentence: They're ashamed ___ their behaviour at the match.
The judge acquitted her ___ all charges.
gaps.explanation: 'Acquit somebody of a charge' is the fixed legal pattern.

gaps.sentence: He was charged ___ driving without insurance.
gaps.explanation: 'Charge somebody with an offence' — legal collocation.

gaps.sentence: Water consists ___ two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
gaps.explanation: consist OF = be made of. Compare 'consist in' (= have as its essence), rare.
